reading: Missed care is the end of a chain that starts with planned staffing, is bent by sick calls and unplanned admissions on the day, and is loaded by patient acuity. Acuity is both a cause of missed care and, where units staff to acuity, a cause of staffing, which is why one abstract loses the association after adjustment and a shift-level study keeps it. The survey measures the nurse's own shift, so linking it to the actual hours of that shift avoids recall of staffing. Licensed practical nurses and night staff are the groups most likely to be under-represented or mismeasured.
